FORM.SUMMARY: If your team has won a trophy or finished as a runner up, you can add it here. You can also add a comment about the trophy.

HELPERS.IS_WINNER: Check this box if your team won the trophy, leave it unselected if the team was the runner up.
HELPERS.IS_FINAL: Check this box if your team reached the final of a cup competition. For a league competition, leave it unselected.
HELPERS.OPPONENT: Enter the name of the opponent team in the final match of the competition.

ADD_TROPHY.ERROR: There was an error adding the trophy. Please try again.

EDIT_TROPHY.ERROR: There was an error updating the trophy. Please try again.
